transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the package-lock routine going for the 'Midnight Arcade' delivery package. I need signoff from rights, post-production, and publicity before I can approve. Please report any required changes on your end so we can finalize this.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I reviewed the countersigned music license this morning. Two required changes for the delivery package: first, the license restricts distribution to the United States and Canada only, so the current worldwide delivery listing needs to be corrected. Second, the required music credit must read exactly 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs,' which differs from our standard music credit. I haven't entered these terms into the delivery tracker yet due to the ongoing rights database migration, but the countersigned license confirms these terms.

transcript.text: I received the broadcaster's completed ingest test today and confirmed that delivery must be an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions. The draft 4K UHD 24 fps master and ordinary English subtitle file will fail the partner's ingest specification. The result is in the post-production test folder. So for post-production signoff, the required changes are: the master must be reformatted as an IMF package at 25 fps, and the subtitles must be replaced with English SDH captions.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I confirmed with the artist's representative this afternoon that publicity for the special is embargoed until June 21. The representative will reject any public release dated earlier than June 21. The approval email is currently attached to the publicity calendar rather than the delivery tracker, so it hasn't been visible in the package-lock routine. For publicity signoff, the required change is: the June 14 publicity release date in the draft package must be corrected to June 21 or later.
